title: The mixed-negative Q8 bound is attained at t=1 and t=2
body:
## Summary
- The inherited conditions `5n >= 11t` and `n ≡ t (mod 2)` force 3 calls at `t = 1` and 6 calls at `t = 2`.
- Three factors of one label multiply that role by `z` times the label, so the witness meets both counts.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no decision for `t` greater than 2.
